summary: A vertically stacked set of collapsible panels, in four variants, with single or multiple selection.

props.name: items

example.title: Where are my files kept?
example.content: On this computer, with a copy in the cloud for every folder you sync.

example.title: How long does Trash keep things?
example.content: 30 days, then the files are deleted for good. Change it in Storage.

example.title: Can I use it offline?
example.content: Yes. Files you keep offline open without a connection and sync when you are back.

props.description: Each item's `value`, `title`, `content` and optional `disabled`. `value` is what `defaultValue`/`value` reference to control which items are open.

props.name: separated
props.description: Draws a rule between each pair of items. Only visible on the `default` variant.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Which built-in open/closed mark the trigger draws. `chevron` rotates one glyph 180 degrees. `plus-minus` swaps between two glyphs with a small rotation flourish.

props.name: indicatorPosition
props.description: Which end of the trigger the indicator sits at.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow more than one item open at once. Off keeps opening one item closed the rest.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Which items start open, by `value`. Pair `value` with `onValueChange` instead if you are controlling it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new open items. Required for a controlled accordion.

props.name: variant
props.description: `default` is a plain list divided by `separator`. `bordered` boxes each item. `ghost` marks the open item with a left border. `subtle` fills the open item's background.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on `bordered` items. The other variants use a fixed radius, since no shape was ever paired with them.

props.name: animated
props.description: The icon's rotation & the panel's height/opacity animation. Turn it off for an instant expand/collapse, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
